chapter_theme: The three voids (முப்பாழ்): letting go of the seven effects gives the void of maya, of the seven causes the void of knowledge, and of their traces the void of calm; these voids are the soul, the Supreme and Siva-Shakti, where speech ends. The speaker crosses the void to Nandi's feet, and at the last even void, heart and form are gone.
structure_note: 2495 and 2496 define the three voids; 2497 is the speaker's own crossing; 2498 and 2499 warn that the void is named more than known; 2500 dissolves the void itself.

2495.reading: Seeing and leaving the seven effects, the void of maya; seeing and leaving the seven causes, the void of knowledge; seeing and ending the traces of effect and cause, the bond ends in the glorious void of calm.
2495.nuance: The seven effects and seven causes recur in 2501 and 2505 and are not listed. வாதனை are the latent traces (vasana). உபசாந்தம் is the stilled calm named in 2474.

2496.reading: The void of maya is the soul, the void of space is the abiding Supreme, and the far third void is the soul pervaded in Siva-Shakti; in that pure form speech comes to its end.
2496.nuance: The three voids are matched to soul, Supreme and union, as the padas were in 2488. வியாப்தம் is pervasion; சொல் முடிவு, the end of words, fits the wordless void of 2498.

2497.reading: To join the feet of Nandi, the Lord who rides his bull gladly every day and has no rival, I take the void as my way, cross it, and come to rest in the void that has shaken off even that imagining.
2497.nuance: There are two voids here: the one crossed, and the one beyond imagining where the speaker comes to rest. The bull-rider gives a personal Lord in a chapter otherwise abstract.

2498.reading: The wordless void in which turiya subsides, the foolish call the rare Paramparam; but who knows the rare ground they praise by that name?
2498.nuance: ஆதர் usually means the ignorant, which makes the verse a rebuke to those who name it without knowing; if it is taken as 'those who love', the last line is a wondering question instead.

2499.reading: When the thirty-six are gone and 'nama' with the rest has withdrawn, the true Supreme, standing apart, joins one in the final breath; is this not what comes when one comes clear in 'Sivayanama', which the unclear cannot grasp?
2499.nuance: In the five letters tradition reads ந and ம as concealment and impurity, so dropping நம leaves சிவாய, Siva, grace and soul. Line 2 (வேறா கயபரை யா) is obscure, and வாசி may be breath or utterance.

2500.reading: For those who know the true nature, that the heart is form and form is the heart, there is no hollow, no mound, no void, no heart and no form.
2500.nuance: The verse closes a chapter on voids by denying the void too. பள்ளம், திடர் (hollow, mound) are the uneven ground of distinctions.

links.note: 2497 ends at rest in a void beyond imagining; 2500 says that for those who know, there is no void either, nor heart nor form.
2503 maps the letters சி, வா, ய to Siva, the Supreme and the soul; 2499 drops நம to leave those letters as the clear form of the mantra.

source_issues: 2499 line 2 (வேறா கயபரை யா) is obscure and may be corrupt.
